category_description: Home loans, first home buyers and property in Australia.
subcategory_description: Schemes and limits that help first home buyers.
label: Minimum deposit for first home buyers
context: The least a first home buyer can put down under the scheme, with the Australian Government guaranteeing the rest of the lender’s risk to the lender.

label: Minimum deposit for single parents or legal guardians
context: The least a single parent or legal guardian can put down under the scheme.

label: Price cap, New South Wales capital city and regional centres
context: Applies in the capital city and the regional centres of Central Coast, Coffs Harbour–Grafton, Illawarra, Mid North Coast, Richmond-Tweed, and Newcastle and Lake Macquarie. Both the purchase price and the home’s value must be at or below the cap.

label: Price cap, rest of New South Wales
context: Applies everywhere in the state outside the capital city and the listed regional centres.

label: Price cap, Victoria capital city and Geelong
context: Applies in the capital city and Geelong.

label: Price cap, rest of Victoria
context: Applies everywhere in the state outside the capital city and Geelong.

label: Price cap, Queensland capital city and regional centres
context: Applies in the capital city, the Gold Coast and the Sunshine Coast.

label: Price cap, rest of Queensland
context: Applies everywhere in the state outside the capital city, the Gold Coast and the Sunshine Coast.

label: Price cap, Western Australia capital city
Price cap, rest of Western Australia
context: Applies everywhere in the state outside the capital city.

label: Price cap, South Australia capital city
Price cap, rest of South Australia
context: Applies everywhere in the state outside the capital city.

label: Price cap, rest of Tasmania
context: Applies everywhere in the state outside the capital city.

label: Price cap, Australian Capital Territory
context: Applies in all areas of the territory.

label: Price cap, Northern Territory capital city
Price cap, rest of the Northern Territory
context: Applies everywhere in the territory outside the capital city.

label: Price cap, Jervis Bay Territory and Norfolk Island
context: Applies in Jervis Bay Territory and on Norfolk Island.

label: Price cap, Christmas Island and Cocos (Keeling) Islands
context: Applies on Christmas Island and the Cocos (Keeling) Islands.
